description: Any Hyperliquid account by address: perp account value, notional, margin used, withdrawable, leverage and unrealized PnL; every open position with side, size, entry, value, PnL, ROE, liquidation price, leverage and cumulative funding since open (Hyperliquid's cumFunding); spot balances; and up to 50 open orders. Public on-chain data from Hyperliquid's info API, read live. Use to track a trader, a vault or your own agent's book. Example: address=0x31ca8395cf837de08b24da3f660e77761dfb974b. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: hyperliquid_account
title: Hyperliquid account, positions and PnL
